test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A can complete a piece of work in 12 days while B can the same work in 18 days. If they both work together, then how many days will be required to finish the work?
solution:
GIVEN:

Time taken by A = 12 days,

Time is taken by B = 18 days.

CALCULATION:

LCM of 12 and 18 = 36,

Total work = 36 unit

1 day work of A = 36/12 = 3 unit

1 day work of B = 36/18 = 2 unit

Time taken by both together to complete the whole work = 36 / 5

⇒ 7.2 days

**They both finish the work together in 7.2 days.**
